config.name: evaluation.interval
config.description: the interval to evaluate alarm rules, in seconds

config.name: evaluation.threadNum
config.description: the number of threads used to evaluate alarm rules

config.name: alarm.repeatInterval
config.description: the alarm default repeat interval, in seconds

config.name: managementServerDirectoriesToMonitor
config.description: the list of directories to monitor on management servers, multiple directories split by commas

config.name: scrape.interval
config.description: the interval that zwatch pulls data from monitoring agents, in seconds

config.name: resolution.defaultAlgorithm.maxSamples
config.description: the max samples returned by default resolution algorithm when GetMetricData API queries a large time range; it only works if the period field is not set in the API

config.name: countCacheExpireSecTime
config.description: EventData and AlarmData count cache expiration time secs

config.name: minimumCountAmountAllowedAddedToCache
config.description: The minimum amount allowed to be added to the cache
